title: Installer: a real, laid-out DMG window instead of Finder defaults
description: make_dmg.sh produced a DMG with zero window layout - whatever a user's own Finder window settings happened to be, not a deliberate drag-to-Applications arrangement like real Mac installers have. Adds the standard technique (mount read-write, lay out via a real Finder AppleScript - sized window, icon view, Playdock.app and an /Applications symlink positioned side by side - then re-compress to the same read-only UDZO path).
commit_message: Lay out the DMG window (icon positions, sized window)
tests: ./Scripts/build_app.sh && ./Scripts/make_dmg.sh 0.0.0-test (manual: open the DMG, confirm the window is sized/laid out, then rm dist/Playdock-0.0.0-test.dmg)
